CONFIGURED.note: control arm: empty payload CONFIGURED (principle OFF)

SELECTED.note: offline deterministic selection: the arm payload is the complete selection output for this arm

SUBMITTED.note: composed actor prompt submitted to the offline actor transport

HOST_ACCEPTED.note: offline-stub scope: the actor transport IS the host boundary — acceptance is the transport handing the prompt to the controlled actor loop (never a claim about a real host)

CONTEXT_PRESENT.note: empty payload trivially present (nothing to leak)

RUNTIME_LOADED.note: offline actor loop consumed the prompt (attempt record binds the executed trace)
